name: The Odds API
description: The Odds API (the-odds-api.com) v4: betting odds from US, UK, EU and Australian bookmakers for soccer, NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, tennis and more, event odds with player props, live scores, participants and historical odds. Not the odds-api.io service.
instructions:
## The Odds API
This connector reads The Odds API v4 (`https://api.the-odds-api.com/v4`, the-odds-api.com): betting odds from many bookmakers in the US, UK, EU and Australia for soccer, American football, basketball, baseball, ice hockey, tennis, cricket, MMA and more, plus scores and historical odds. Every tool only reads. It is a different service from the **Odds API** connector (`odds-api`, odds-api.io): use this one when your key comes from the-odds-api.com.

**Setup.** Get a key at https://the-odds-api.com (a free plan with 500 credits a month exists) and paste it into `THE_ODDS_API_KEY`. It is sent as the `apiKey` query parameter and is never a tool argument.

**Credits.** Most calls spend credits from the monthly quota, and every answer reports the balance in `_headers`: `x-requests-remaining`, `x-requests-used` and `x-requests-last` (the cost of that call). Read it and tell the user when it runs low.
- Free: `the_odds_api_list_sports`, `the_odds_api_list_events`.
- 1 credit: `the_odds_api_get_scores` (2 with `days_from`), `the_odds_api_get_event_markets`, `the_odds_api_list_participants`, `the_odds_api_get_historical_events`.
- Odds: markets times regions. One market in one region costs 1; `h2h,spreads,totals` in `us,eu` costs 6. Ten bookmakers in `bookmakers` count as one region. Start with one market and one region.
- Historical odds (paid plans only): 10 credits per market per region. Ask the user before calling them.

**Workflow.**
1. `the_odds_api_list_sports` for the sport key (`soccer_epl`, `basketball_nba`, `americanfootball_nfl` ...).
2. `the_odds_api_list_events` for event ids and start times (free).
3. `the_odds_api_get_odds` for a whole sport, or `the_odds_api_get_event_markets` then `the_odds_api_get_event_odds` for one game, including player props.
4. `the_odds_api_get_scores` for live scores and recent results.

**Reading the data.** Times are ISO 8601 in UTC. Odds are decimal unless `odds_format` is american. Each bookmaker has `last_update`; prices change constantly, so quote the time. Soccer `h2h` has three outcomes including Draw. Implied probability = 1 / decimal odds.

**Errors.** 401: key missing, wrong or out of credits. 422: an invalid parameter, such as an unknown market or region, or a historical call on a plan without history. 429: too many requests at once; wait a second and retry. 404 on an event: it has started or finished and is no longer listed.
prerequisites: An API key from the-odds-api.com (free plan: 500 credits a month). Historical odds need a paid plan.

THE_ODDS_API_KEY.label: API key
THE_ODDS_API_KEY.help: Sign up at the-odds-api.com; the key arrives by e-mail and is shown on your account page.
THE_ODDS_API_KEY.patternMessage: A key from the-odds-api.com is 32 lowercase hex characters.

verifyHints.401: The Odds API refused the key: it is wrong, or the monthly credits are used up. Check the key on your the-odds-api.com account page.
verifyHints.429: Too many requests at once. Wait a second and try again.

tools.name: the_odds_api_list_sports
tools.description: Sports and competitions The Odds API covers, with the sport key the other tools need, group, title, whether it is in season and whether it has outright (futures) markets. Free: costs no credits.

all.description: true to also list competitions that are out of season.

tools.name: the_odds_api_list_events
tools.description: Upcoming and live events of a sport with event id, teams and start time, without odds. Free: costs no credits. Use it to find the event id for the event tools.

sport.description: Sport key from the_odds_api_list_sports, e.g. soccer_epl, soccer_germany_bundesliga, americanfootball_nfl, basketball_nba, baseball_mlb, icehockey_nhl, tennis_atp_paris. upcoming covers the next games across all sports (odds only).

commence_time_from.description: Only events starting at or after this time, ISO 8601 UTC such as 2026-10-20T00:00:00Z.

commence_time_to.description: Only events starting at or before this time, ISO 8601 UTC.

event_ids.description: Comma separated event ids to narrow the list.

tools.name: the_odds_api_get_odds
tools.description: Odds for the upcoming and live games of a sport from many bookmakers, per market (h2h, spreads, totals, outrights). Costs credits: number of markets times number of regions (1 for one market in one region). Keep to one region and one market unless more are needed; narrow with event_ids or a time window.

sport.description: Sport key from the_odds_api_list_sports, e.g. soccer_epl, soccer_germany_bundesliga, americanfootball_nfl, basketball_nba, baseball_mlb, icehockey_nhl, tennis_atp_paris. upcoming covers the next games across all sports (odds only).

regions.description: Bookmaker region(s), comma separated: us, us2, uk, eu, au. Each region costs credits; default eu. Leave regions out only when you pass bookmakers.

markets.description: Market(s), comma separated: h2h (match winner, 1X2 for soccer), spreads (handicap), totals (over/under), outrights (futures), h2h_lay. Each market costs credits; default h2h.

bookmakers.description: Bookmaker keys, comma separated, e.g. pinnacle,bet365,williamhill. Overrides regions; every 10 bookmakers count as one region.

event_ids.description: Comma separated event ids to narrow the list.

commence_time_from.description: Only events starting at or after this time, ISO 8601 UTC such as 2026-10-20T00:00:00Z.

commence_time_to.description: Only events starting at or before this time, ISO 8601 UTC.

tools.name: the_odds_api_get_scores
tools.description: Live scores and, with days_from, results of games completed in the last 1 to 3 days for a sport. Costs 1 credit, 2 with days_from. Covers the major leagues; not every sport has scores.

sport.description: Sport key from the_odds_api_list_sports, e.g. soccer_epl, soccer_germany_bundesliga, americanfootball_nfl, basketball_nba, baseball_mlb, icehockey_nhl, tennis_atp_paris. upcoming covers the next games across all sports (odds only).

days_from.description: Also return games completed in the last 1 to 3 days (2 credits instead of 1).

event_ids.description: Comma separated event ids to narrow the list.

tools.name: the_odds_api_get_event_odds
tools.description: Odds of one event in any market the bookmakers offer, including player props, alternate lines and period markets (e.g. player_pass_tds, alternate_spreads, h2h_q1, btts, draw_no_bet). Costs credits: markets returned times regions. Call the_odds_api_get_event_markets first to see which markets exist.

sport.description: Sport key from the_odds_api_list_sports, e.g. soccer_epl, soccer_germany_bundesliga, americanfootball_nfl, basketball_nba, baseball_mlb, icehockey_nhl, tennis_atp_paris. upcoming covers the next games across all sports (odds only).
